name: Leading Children
overview: Scripture affirms that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents as His reward. The responsibility of leading children is emphasized through training them in the way they should go, promising that such instruction will have lasting impact. Fathers are specifically admonished not to provoke their children to anger, but rather to nurture and admonish them according to the Lord’s guidance, ensuring they are not discouraged or led astray.
